detectionRule: Reject an Ethernet fixed-corridor candidate when a TX or RX pair net has more than the source-backed PHY-to-transformer topology endpoints, or when its crystal/load network is not physically local to the PHY.
rootCause: The generated pin map directly joined W5500 PHY-side pair nets to the MagJack, ESD device, and supposed termination parts without a source-backed cable-side versus PHY-side topology. The placement engine also separated the crystal/load network from the W5500.
fixStrategy: Require a source-backed W5500-to-selected-MagJack schematic before routing: distinguish PHY-side and cable-side nets, attach ESD only at the approved cable-side location, remove unsupported termination topology, place crystal/load/EXRES/TOCAP/1V2/AVDD support beside the W5500, then derive pair geometry from a selected four-layer stackup.
regressionTest: A Board010 topology gate must reject multi-drop Ethernet pair trees and remote PHY timing/analog support before the candidate router is allowed to create copper.
futureAutoApplyRule: For Ethernet categories, run source-backed topology and local-support placement checks before pair routing, DRC, or manufacturing readiness.
